no family history of breast cancer
had been menopausal for 5 years
denied eating frogs or snakes
recalled drinking impure water
migratory discomfort and pain in the right axilla and upper-outer quadrant
a mobile lump was palpated

an oval, low-echo mass with well-delineated contours, measuring 1.8 × 1.2 × 0.4 cm (BIRADS 4a) and closely abutting the pectoralis major
two small hypoechoic masses in the fat layer, measuring 0.5 × 0.3 cm and 0.3 × 0.2 cm
